QUOTE: MBEDTLS_CT_ASM  <=  MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM && __GNUC__ && (not armcc5)
   + one of: ARM / AArch64 / x86-64 / x86 (by __arm__, __aarch64__, __x86_64__, __i386__)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the selection is a preprocessor decision, with MBEDTLS_CT_ASM computed from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM and compiler predefined macros (__GNUC__, __arm__, and so on). It does not say outright that no config entry sets it, but the derivation is clear.
